subject: Post-signature cutover playbook & transfer plan — phased rollout, canary, migration, training
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Kara Owens <kara.owens@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-signature cutover playbook & transfer plan — phased rollout, canary, migration, training

Kara — congrats again on the signature. As discussed on the call, attached is a first-pass operational playbook we want to fold into the mutual action plan (MAP). Highlights: 

- Timeline summary (week-by-week): 4-week pilot (internal canary), 6-week phased rollout across 3 regions, full production cutover target by 2027-03-01.
- Roles / RACI: Redwood (Ops owner: Marcus), NovumHealth (Product lead: Kara), Training (Novum LMS + Redwood enablement).
- Canary gates: latency & error KPIs, traffic cap at 5% initial, automated rollback on sustained SLA breach.
- Migration approach: dual-write for 48 hours followed by read-swap controlled window; DB cutover only during maintenance window (2–4 AM local).
- Training: 3 instructor-led sessions + on-demand recordings; certification quiz for first 50 power users.

Attached: MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan with milestones), cutover_checklist.pdf, training_schedule.csv. 

Requesting: please confirm accept/modify timeline and confirm who from Novum will own the procurement checklist items (procurement@novumhealth.com is on the thread to coordinate PO/contract handoffs).

Thanks — I’ll set a short follow-up with Marcus and Tessa to align on operational runbooks and monitoring hooks.

Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success (Mid-Market)
Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0127

Thanks Kimberly — this looks comprehensive and aligned with what we discussed. A few quick notes from my side: 

- Timeline: Novum prefers the production cutover no earlier than 2027-03-15 to accommodate an internal compliance window; can we push the final cutover by two weeks if gates hold?
- Canary: yes to a 5% traffic cap; add an explicit data residency validation during canary (our compliance team requires a verification check).
- Migration: can you confirm rollback steps for toggled features? We need documented exact commands and ownership for DB read-swap.
- Training: request that Redwood lead at least one live session tailored to our triage team (they use a different ticketing flow).

Procurement will confirm PO timeline by Friday — cc'd procurement contact. I’ll loop in our Platform lead once procurement confirms dates.

—Kara

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 08:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature cutover playbook & transfer plan — internal ops prep

Kimberly / Tessa — internal checklist and owners below. I’ll prepare the cutover runbook and a one-click rollback script for the canary. High-level plan: 

1) Pre-canary (Week -2 to 0):
   - Validate infra (GPU pools reserved, model variant pinned) — Owner: Marcus
   - Monitoring hooks (token-level tracing + KV cache sanity) — Owner: Priyom
   - DR test scheduled in staging — Owner: Tessa

2) Canary (Week 1):
   - Open 5% of traffic with automated throttling; hold at gate for 48 hours for latency & error metrics.
   - Data residency validation step (manual verify) with Novum — Marcus to coordinate.
   - Rollback: toggle traffic back to fallback model + purge cache; rollback script path: /ops/cutover/rollback_v1.sh

3) Phased migration (Weeks 2–6):
   - Ramp windows: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% or until gate failures.
   - Dual-write for user metadata for 48 hours at 25% window then monitor diffs.

4) Training & Handover (parallel):
   - Instructor session 1 (Day -3): overview for platform/triage.
   - Session 2 (Day 0): live runthrough of monitoring & escalation paths.
   - On-demand recording and quiz for certification.

I’ll attach the preliminary runbook in our shared Drive and draft the rollback script for review by EOD Thursday. Tessa — please confirm DR test window availability. Kimberly — recommend we set a dry-run date two weeks before canary to exercise the automation.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

- Data residency validation: added a manual verify step in the canary gating checklist (Marcus will lead).
- Rollback steps: Marcus will publish the exact commands and the rollback script path by EOD Thursday. We’ll also add runbook snippets to the MAP for clarity.
- Training: Redwood will lead the first live session for your triage team; Tessa will tailor the slides to Novum’s ticketing flow.

Next actions: 
- Procurement to confirm PO by Friday, 2027-01-22.
- Marcus & Tessa to schedule dry-run date (target week of 2027-02-22).
- Kimberly to share updated MAP folder and short deck for exec alignment.

If that all sounds good I’ll lock the dates and publish the MAP link to the exec thread.

Best,
